description: **`ctl.py` `bash()` says when its finder fails**: `harness/ctl.py:48-60`: `bash()` catches every exception from the Git Bash finder and falls back to plain `bash` without a word, which on Windows is the WSL launcher the finder exists to avoid; keep the fallback but print one stderr line when the finder fails to load Why: the failure is invisible today; in the next job that changes `ctl.py` anyway Raised: napoleon J22 review Later 4, 2026-11-04
title: `ctl.py` `bash()` says when its finder fails
